title: История майонеза и идея соуса  (The Story of Mayonnaise and the Sauce Idea)

segments.t: Out in the courtyard, Max complains that he cannot invent a masterpiece without expensive ingredients. Katya tells him how a French chef invented mayonnaise during a siege using only olive oil and eggs—giving Max the idea to create a sauce! Listen first.
Да это всё полная чушь, зря время потерял!
Макс, как твои успехи, придумал что-нибудь новое?
Как я придумаю, шеф запретил мне брать дорогие продукты!
А ты знаешь, как во Франции придумали майонез?
Город был в осаде, не было ничего, кроме масла и яиц.
Солдаты уже не могли больше есть яичницу и омлет.
И тогда повар придумал для них вкусный майонез!
Ну ладно, приготовлю что-нибудь простое и подешевле.
Подумай, без чего немыслима настоящая французская кухня?
Конечно, хороший соус, ты абсолютно права, точно!
Я сегодня обязательно придумаю свой фирменный соус!
Отличная идея, а соус будет к чему?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Да это всё полная чушь, зря время потерял!

'All of this is complete nonsense, I wasted my time for nothing!' Max declares that all of this is complete nonsense he wasted his time for nothing as the tension in the room peaks. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Макс, как твои успехи, придумал что-нибудь новое?

'Max, how is your progress, have you invented anything new?' Here asking how Max's progress have Max invented anything new is shows Katya looking for the real truth. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Как я придумаю, шеф запретил мне брать дорогие продукты!
'How can I invent anything, the chef forbade me to take expensive ingredients!' Insisting that how can he invent anything the forbade him to take expensive ingredients shows Max is not backing down.
А ты знаешь, как во Франции придумали майонез?

'Do you know how they invented mayonnaise in France?' Asking whether Max knows how they invented mayonnaise in France cuts straight through the tension between Katya and Max. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Город был в осаде, не было ничего, кроме масла и яиц.

'The city was under siege, and there was nothing except oil and eggs.' Katya explains that the city was under siege and there was nothing except oil and eggs, keeping her voice calm and direct. Russian stacks "never" or "nothing" together with "not", doubling the refusal for extra weight.
Солдаты уже не могли больше есть яичницу и омлет.
'The soldiers could no longer eat fried eggs and omelettes.' Realizing that the soldiers could no longer eat fried eggs and omelettes changes how Katya handles the situation.
И тогда повар придумал для них вкусный майонез!

'And then the cook invented delicious mayonnaise for them!' Over the work and the story, Katya lets her real feelings show. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.
Ну ладно, приготовлю что-нибудь простое и подешевле.
'Well alright, I will cook something simple and a bit cheaper.' Even though alright he will cook something simple and a bit cheaper, Max keeps a steady face in front of Katya.
Подумай, без чего немыслима настоящая французская кухня?
'Think, without what is true French cuisine unthinkable?' Wondering if think without what is true French cuisine unthinkable shows Katya caught off guard.
Конечно, хороший соус, ты абсолютно права, точно!

'Of course, a good sauce, you are absolutely right, exactly!' Insisting that a good sauce Katya is absolutely right exactly shows Max is not backing down. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Я сегодня обязательно придумаю свой фирменный соус!

'Today I will definitely invent my own signature sauce!' Once today he will definitely invent his own signature sauce, Max makes sure Katya hears every word. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Отличная идея, а соус будет к чему?

'Great idea, and what will the sauce be served with?' Katya asks whether great idea and what will the sauce be served, refusing to let the point slide. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Макс, как твои успехи, придумал что-нибудь новое?

Inspired by the story of mayonnaise, Max decides to craft a special sauce for salmon! Next, let's see how Chef Barinov catches Senya and Fedya in Scene Nine. See you next time!
До завтра!
